item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description:
That's close enough — 81 words, roughly 30 seconds aloud. Here's the brief:
Today, let's talk Mindset. Your day is built around perspective: quiet time this morning, a reminder that you can choose how you see the past and future, and check-ins on whether this moment fits the life you're building. There's room to catch yourself projecting before it becomes a story, and to trade negative patterns for grace. None of it works unless you pause and ask. Action: next time you're sure what someone else is thinking, stop and check if you're mind-reading.
